summary: No new receipt this turn, so I aligned the durable knowledge with the findings and requested the last reproducibility run. I also requested one repeat of the revision carrying the client-contract observation, since that observation depends on the stale leader still considering itself leader when the confirmation is issued and when the old majority elects (one earlier revision saw it step down first).
